title: EMP from nuclear blast travels through dimensions

tellings.quote: The one thing we found out is that the EMP wave from a nuclear blast kind of travels through multiple dimensions.

plain: The electromagnetic pulse from a nuclear blast, a burst of energy that knocks out electronics, is said to travel through more than one dimension. The musician Tom DeLonge says this on the show as something "we found out," without saying who found it or how. If true, a nuclear explosion would be felt beyond the ordinary world we see.
